# Sound and Music

> A free Jackbox-style party joust in the browser. One laptop or TV is the arena. Everyone else joins on their phone as a controller. Riders flap to fly, strike from above, and ride a live synthesized beat.

Live game: https://sound-and-motion.onrender.com
Source: https://github.com/molokochris/sound_and_motion

## What it is

Sound and Music is a multiplayer party game. You do not install anything to play in the browser. One person hosts the arena on a shared screen. Everyone else opens the site on their phone (or the optional Android APK) and becomes a rider.

Phones do not need the same Wi-Fi. Pages and the WebSocket relay are hosted on Render.

## Play

1. Open https://sound-and-motion.onrender.com on a laptop or TV. Tap **Host the arena**.
2. A 4-letter room code and QR appear. The QR is `https://sound-and-motion.onrender.com/controller?room=ABCD`.
3. Phones scan the QR or tap **Join a room** and type the code plus a name.
4. When names show up on the big screen, hit **START JOUST**.
5. Last rider standing — or highest score when the 3:00 clock runs out — wins.

Up to 8 riders per room. Multiple hosts can run at the same time; each host gets a different room code.

## Controls

On the phone:

- Tap left / right to move, tap **FLAP** to fly.
- The phone buzzes on every beat. Flap on that buzz for a stronger "perfect flap" (+10).

On the arena:

- Hit another rider from **above** to unhorse them (+100).
- Hitting at the same height knocks both riders back.
- Don't fall in the lava. Each rider has **3 lives**.
- Every 8 beats, **the drop** spikes gravity for two beats.

## How it is built

The host tab is the single source of truth (same model as Jackbox). Phones only send `left` / `right` / `flap` over WebSocket. `server.js` is a static file server plus a room relay — no game logic on the server.

Music is synthesized live with the Web Audio API (no audio files).

- Perfect flaps — within ~130ms of a beat: 35% more lift and +10
- The drop — every 8 beats, gravity ×1.4 for two beats; screen shake
- Tempo ramp — 128 BPM climbs toward 176 as the match goes on

Optional native phone controller: `mobile/` (Expo). Same WebSocket, plus a camera QR scanner.
